_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score band 39-46 plus canceled flows and no breaker inside 24h keep the coil intact; HOLD is the graded base-rate call.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on phase=Anxiety and non-directional stance; narrative adds no opposing forward call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC range-bound, F&G 30-45, 30d momentum ~50, funding flat next session
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G mid-20s + negative funding + downside accel (toward Denial/Panic) OR ETF/liquidity up + F&G mid-40s (toward Complacency)
